seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Collierville, Tennessee for 2026: 7 family events, 5 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Collierville is an Official 2026 Hallmark Christmas Town, with 250,000 lights on its historic Town Square, Santa in the Gazebo every Saturday and model trains in the old Depot.
celebrates: The Town of Collierville runs Christmas in Collierville around its historic Town Square, lit with 250,000 holiday lights from November 24 through January 4, 2027. Santa sits in the Gazebo on four Saturdays, model trains run in the Depot, and horse drawn carriages roll nightly. The town's 49th Christmas Parade follows Byhalia Road on December 4, the Morton Museum hosts Santa story time and craft programs, Carriage Crossing holds Frosty Fest, and a self guided Holiday Lights Tour maps displays across town.
lastyear: The Town of Collierville has not archived its 2025 schedule on its Christmas pages, so this page is built from the town's 2026 calendar. A post on the Collierville Parks Facebook page says the Town's Christmas in Collierville program was honored with a Downtown Destination (Non-Business) Award at the Main Street awards, and the town now calls itself an Official 2026 Hallmark Christmas Town.
facts: Collierville says 250,000 holiday lights illuminate its historic Town Square and district from November 24 through January 4, 2027. The Morton Museum of Collierville History at 196 Main Street offers free admission, and its December programs include a story time with Santa and corn husk angel ornaments. The Collierville Christmas Parade is the town's 49th annual and has no rain date, and carriage rides are provided by Cunningham Tours.
trains: Collierville's Depot Visitors Center on North Rowlett Street hosts Model Train Displays from 10 am to 2 pm on December 5, 12 and 19 during Christmas in Collierville Saturdays, alongside photos with Santa in the Gazebo. For more rail history, the Memphis Railroad and Trolley Museum is inside Central Station on South Main Street in Memphis, and the MATA heritage streetcars run downtown.

faq: When can kids see Santa in Collierville?

Santa sits in the Gazebo on Town Square on Saturdays November 28, December 5, 12 and 19, from 10 am to 2 pm, with free photos. He also reads at the Morton Museum on December 11 and appears at Frosty Fest at Carriage Crossing on December 12.
Are there model trains in Collierville?
Model Train Displays run in the Depot from 10 am to 2 pm on December 5, 12 and 19 during Christmas in Collierville Saturdays.
How much are Collierville carriage rides?
$30 per trip. Carriages hold 5 to 6 people and run nightly from 5 to 8 pm from November 27 to December 30, except December 24 and 25.
When is the Collierville Christmas Parade?
Friday, December 4, 2026, from 7 to 9 pm on Byhalia Road. There is no rain date.
Are there free Christmas events in Collierville?
Santa photos on the Square, the parade, Frosty Fest, the Morton Museum programs and the Music in the Gazebo concerts are listed as free. Carriage rides are $30 per trip.
